summary: MSc Data Science student at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg whose strongest work is the evaluation and validation of machine learning and deep learning methods against datasets and benchmarks. Built and evaluated 10+ production-ready models during an AI and ML internship, including supervised forecasting on temporally ordered sales data with XGBoost at 96.1% R² and an 18% cut in forecast error, and implemented full training, validation and inference pipelines in PyTorch. Co-author of a peer-reviewed deep-learning paper in the ICISD 2025 proceedings, Atlantis Press (Springer Nature), benchmarked at 95.79% mAP@0.5. Solid statistics, Python and Git; English at full professional proficiency.

bullets: Evaluated and validated 10+ production-ready models across the supervised and unsupervised spectrum, choosing the metric that fitted each problem: 95%+ ROC-AUC on a Support Vector Machine tuned by GridSearchCV hyperparameter search, 96%+ accuracy on breast-cancer diagnosis with Logistic Regression, R² above 0.90 on housing-price regression.
Built a Walmart weekly-sales forecasting model with XGBoost on temporally ordered sales data, reaching 96.1% R² and reducing forecast error by 18%.
Recognised as Best Performer of the cohort across 8 end-to-end machine learning projects.
Segmented 200 customers into five clusters with K-Means at a silhouette score of 0.55.
Ran exploratory data analysis on the Titanic dataset covering distribution analysis, missing-value treatment and feature relationships.
Set up evaluation loops against Vertex AI managed endpoints to measure and improve the quality of model output after deployment.
Built an ATS Resume Checker powered by large language models: parsing resumes, scoring them against job descriptions and returning structured feedback.
Designed and iterated LLM prompts and embedding-based retrieval on Google Vertex AI.
Operated and supported VMware virtualisation infrastructure and set up monitoring for cloud workloads.
Automated recurring infrastructure tasks and enforced security guidelines across managed environments.
Implemented the full training, validation and inference pipeline for an American Sign Language image-recognition system, including data augmentation to improve generalisation.
Built the recognition model as a Convolutional Neural Network in PyTorch.

publications.description: Final-year thesis project on live CCTV feeds. Weapon detection with YOLOv11 and hard negative mining to suppress false positives from visually similar objects; face recognition via a ResNet-based detector, FaceNet embeddings and an SVM classifier. Benchmarked results: 95.79% mAP@0.5 with precision and recall both at 0.93 for weapon detection, and 93.75% accuracy for face recognition. Led as team leader; personally optimised the object-detection model for real-time inference on standard hardware, integrated the face-recognition pipeline with privacy and ethical considerations in the design, and tuned the system to cut false alarms while holding accuracy. Awarded Best Paper at ICISD 2025.
